description: This file defines the OrganizationDao class, which manages database access and operations for Organization entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve and save organization information, as well as updating the organizational structure.

classes.name: OrganizationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Organization entities, providing methods to retrieve and update organization data in the database.

methods.name: getOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Retrieves the general information of the organization (entity with ID 1) from the database.

methods.name: saveOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Saves and updates the general information of the organization within a transactional context, handling exceptions to ensure data integrity.

methods.name: updateOrganizationStructure
methods.description: Updates the organizational structure by modifying the base Subunit's name to match the organization's name.
